question: Which of the following operating systems guarantees a response within specified time constraints?
solution:
The correct answer is a __**Real-time Operating system.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Real-time operating system**__

 __
 
• Real-time operating systems are used in **environments where a large number of events,** mostly external to the computer system, must be accepted and processed in a short time within certain deadlines.
 
• The processing in this type of system must occur within the specified constraints.
 
• **Examples of the real-time operating systems**: Airline traffic control systems, Command Control Systems, Airlines reservation system, Heart Peacemaker, Network Multimedia Systems, Robot, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Distributed operating system**

 
 
• A distributed operating system is an essential type of operating system. 
 
• They use many central processors to serve multiple real-time applications and users.
 
• It connects multiple computers via a single communication channel.
 
• They are also known as** loosely coupled systems.**
 
 
 
• **Time-sharing operating system**__
 __
 
• **A time-sharing operating system allows multiple users to share computers simultaneously.**
 
• A time-sharing operating system uses CPU scheduling and multi-programming to provide each with a small portion of a shared computer at once.
 
• Examples of time Sharing are **Multics, Unix.**
 
 
 
• **​​Interactive operating system**__
 
 
• An interactive operating system is one that allows the user to directly interact with the operating system whilst one or more programs are running.
 
• Both **the UNIX operating system and DOS (Disk Operating System)** are classic examples.
